decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that this application for the installation of a double mobile classroom would be acceptable and would not be detrimental to the amenities of the adjoining and neighbouring properties.  On balance, the development is in accordance with ENV-B.1.1 	(New Development), C.2.1 (Educational Facilities) and C.4.1 (Facilities for Young Children) T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 3 - The building hereby permitted shall be removed].  [The use hereby permitted shall be discontinued] and the land restored to its former condition on or before 6 September in accordance with a scheme of work submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.
An agreed note showing the condition of the site before works begin should be attached to a permission granted subject to this condition.

Condition : 4 - The development shall not be occupied until two Victoria plum trees at either end of the position of the mobile classroom have been planted in accordance with a scheme submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing.
description: Installation of a double mobile classroom to site.
